signature.name: VTask.face
signature.type: {k : Type u_1} -> {V : Type u_2} -> {P : Type u_5} -> [Ring k] -> [AddCommGroup V] -> [Module k V] -> [AddTorsor V P] -> {n : ℕ} -> (s : Affine.Simplex k P n) -> {fs : Finset (Fin (n + 1))} -> {m : ℕ} -> (h : fs.card = m + 1) -> Affine.Simplex k P m

conventions.statement: The vertices of the face are indexed by the canonical order embedding of `fs` into `Fin (n+1)`, so the $i$-th vertex of the face is the $i$-th smallest element of `fs` as a vertex of the original simplex.
conventions.note: This means the face vertex ordering is always consistent with the natural ordering on `Fin (n+1)`, regardless of how `fs` was constructed.

conventions.statement: Affine independence of the face simplex is inherited from the ambient simplex and requires no additional hypothesis.
conventions.note: Any sub-collection of affinely independent points is itself affinely independent.
